# GWS Workflow: Email to Task

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — one cross-service workflow of the gws CLI: convert a Gmail message into a Google Tasks entry, using the email subject as the task title and the snippet as notes, in the default task list or a chosen one (--tasklist). Requires the gws CLI and a paid Google Workspace account — there is no free tier for this CLI. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: the recipe explicitly says to confirm with the user before executing — it creates a real task; gws-shared must be read first for auth and global flags; the skill documents the command — it doesn't set up your Google Cloud auth for you. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
